response.sql:
WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(CASE WHEN ss.boxy IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz IS NOT NULL AND ss.boxz != 0 THEN ss.boxy / ss.boxz END) AS ratio_avg,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM scanspatial ss
  JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS cross_avg FROM grouped_data
),
kept_sources AS (
  SELECT 
    gd.ratio_avg,
    gd.record_count,
    ac.cross_avg
  FROM grouped_data gd
  CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
  WHERE gd.record_count > ac.cross_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(ratio_avg) AS avg_ratio,
  SUM(record_count) AS total_records,
  AVG(record_count - cross_avg) AS avg_excess
FROM kept_sources

assumptions.assumption: Records where boxz = 0 are excluded from the boxy/boxz ratio calculation to avoid division by zero.

"The number of spatial records" counts all records in each funding-source group, including those with missing (NULL) boxy or boxz values, since the request specifies "ignoring missing values" only for the ratio, not the count.

alternatives.interpretation: If "ignoring missing values" applies to both the ratio and the record count, then spatial records with NULL or missing boxy/boxz are filtered out before grouping, so record counts include only rows with valid ratio values.
